### WHY GM GENUINE PARTS AND ACDELCO

Innovation brings challenge and opportunity, and we’re suiting up for both. Because when it comes to
the evolving maintenance, repair, collision and powertrain needs of Chevrolet, Buick, GMC and
Cadillac vehicles, only GM Genuine Parts and ACDelco Original Equipment parts offer true GM Original
Equipment built for what’s next. We also offer ACDelco Gold and Silver parts, our high-quality OE
alternatives.

[.]

## GM ORIGINAL EQUIPMENT

GM Genuine Parts and ACDelco Original Equipment parts are built on innovation that never lets up.
When you choose a true OE part designed, engineered, tested and backed by GM for your vehicle,
you’re making the right choice.

[More on GM Original Equipment][30]

[.]

### AFTERMARKET

ACDelco offers the only aftermarket parts backed by GM. ACDelco’s Gold and Silver lines of premium
aftermarket parts offer a precise fit for GM vehicles and most other makes and models.

[More on Aftermarket Parts][31]

For over 50 years, K&N® has been an industry-leader in automotive filtration and technology—offering
products to increase performance, protection, and longevity in thousands of vehicle applications for
consumers worldwide. K&N® offers a wide range of performance products, including air intake systems,
oil filters, cabin air filters, and home air filters, with a reputation for exceptional quality and
customer service that millions of customers trust. Our creative spirit, passion for pushing limits,
and innovative product design form the foundation of our brand.

## REAL REVIEWS

[

### GREAT BUY

I have been using K&N filters for nearly 20 years. I like the longevity of the filters and the fact
that cleaning them is easy. Power increase along with fuel savings are the reasons I put these
filters on all of my vehicles.

][237]
[

### WILL BUY AGAIN

All I can say is wow! Just installed on my 2015 f150 5.0. Very easy to follow instructions even for
a non mechanic. Total installation time was 35 minutes. Love how it woke up the motor and the sound!

][238]
[

### BEST PRODUCT

Excellent product. Performs as advertised. LOVE the sound. Blown away by the performance. Retired
mechanic of 45 years.

][239]
[

### AWESOME

Great product and immediate effects! Easy to install and sounds good under the hood. Good buy and
great price from K&N!

][240]
[

### GOOD PRODUCT

Fit well and was easy to install. The engine no longer sounds like a giant fan, but a true V6
instead. It definitely helps the truck feel better going up the steep grades at altitude (don't have
to floor it to maintain 65).

][241]
[

### BEST QUALITY

By far, the best air filter product on the market. I haven't used stock filters in many years on

customer service that millions of customers trust. Our creative spirit, passion for pushing limits,
and innovative product design form the foundation of our brand.

# MANN+HUMMEL for a cleaner world: Leadership in filtration since 1941

**Filtration is everywhere. **We filter the air we breathe and the water we drink. Filtration can be
found in our cars, refrigerators and even in our showers and coffee machines. Without filtration,
there is no baby food, no computers, no medicines. And certainly no clean, safe planet.

Can you imagine a world without filtration? A world where almost nothing is safe? Neither can we.

That's why we at MANN+HUMMEL work every day on filtration solutions for **cleaner mobility**,**
cleaner air**,** cleaner water **and** cleaner performance & industry**. As one of the world's
largest filter manufacturers, we want to understand how this world works - and make it a little
better every day. Our goal** **is to **protect people, nature, and machines**. By using filtration
to separate the useful from the harmful.

For more than 85 years, we have stood for leadership in filtration. As a family-owned filter company
with German roots, we operate globally at more than 80 locations. For our filtration solutions, we
use the combined know-how of our employees, a global research and development network, and the
opportunities offered by digitalization. The future is being decided now. That is why today we**
**provide **filtration solutions for tomorrow.**

### Cleaner Mobility

The world is constantly changing. For MANN+HUMMEL, "green mobility" means sustainable mobility
thanks to fine and brake dust particulate filters, and other technological innovations for a range
of vehicles and machines, even for alternative drive systems. This is how we reliably protect the
environment, people, and machines from fine dust and other pollutants.

][120]

[
][122]
[

### Cleaner Air

In order to fight against the increasing air pollution worldwide, we offer cutting-edge filtration
solutions for indoor and outdoor areas. For example, our high-performance air filters provide
protection in industry, while air filters for HVAC systems or mobile indoor air purifiers offer
protection from fine dust, viruses, bacteria, and other pollutants in the air.

][123]

### Cleaner Water

For us, access to clean water is a human right. Our portfolio ranges from reverse osmosis to nano-,
ultra-, micro- and coarse filtration. Water filtration solutions with cartridge and membrane
technologies enable us to solve challenges such as water scarcity and water pollution - for pure
water, sustainable industrial- and wastewater treatment.

Motor and industrial filters from MANN+HUMMEL increase machine efficiency and performance. High
costs caused by incorrect machine maintenance and downtimes can be prevented - with intelligent
filter monitoring, we set standards in predictive maintenance. For industrial processes that run
smoothly.

# MANN+HUMMEL for a cleaner world: Leadership in filtration since 1941

**Filtration is everywhere. **We filter the air we breathe and the water we drink. Filtration can be
found in our cars, refrigerators and even in our showers and coffee machines. Without filtration,
there is no baby food, no computers, no medicines. And certainly no clean, safe planet.

Can you imagine a world without filtration? A world where almost nothing is safe? Neither can we.

That's why we at MANN+HUMMEL work every day on filtration solutions for **cleaner mobility**,**
cleaner air**,** cleaner water **and** cleaner performance & industry**. As one of the world's
largest filter manufacturers, we want to understand how this world works - and make it a little
better every day. Our goal** **is to **protect people, nature, and machines**. By using filtration
to separate the useful from the harmful.

For more than 85 years, we have stood for leadership in filtration. As a family-owned filter company
with German roots, we operate globally at more than 80 locations. For our filtration solutions, we
use the combined know-how of our employees, a global research and development network, and the
opportunities offered by digitalization. The future is being decided now. That is why today we**
**provide **filtration solutions for tomorrow.**

## Separating the useful from the harmful

[
[Cleaner Mobility]
][119]
[

### Cleaner Mobility

The world is constantly changing. For MANN+HUMMEL, "green mobility" means sustainable mobility
thanks to fine and brake dust particulate filters, and other technological innovations for a range
of vehicles and machines, even for alternative drive systems. This is how we reliably protect the
environment, people, and machines from fine dust and other pollutants.

][120]
[ READ MORE ][121]
[
][122]
[

### Cleaner Air

In order to fight against the increasing air pollution worldwide, we offer cutting-edge filtration
solutions for indoor and outdoor areas. For example, our high-performance air filters provide
protection in industry, while air filters for HVAC systems or mobile indoor air purifiers offer
protection from fine dust, viruses, bacteria, and other pollutants in the air.

][123]
[ READ MORE ][124]
[
][125]
[

### Cleaner Water

For us, access to clean water is a human right. Our portfolio ranges from reverse osmosis to nano-,
ultra-, micro- and coarse filtration. Water filtration solutions with cartridge and membrane
technologies enable us to solve challenges such as water scarcity and water pollution - for pure
water, sustainable industrial- and wastewater treatment.

][126]
[ READ MORE ][127]
[
][128]
[

### Cleaner Industry

Motor and industrial filters from MANN+HUMMEL increase machine efficiency and performance. High
costs caused by incorrect machine maintenance and downtimes can be prevented - with intelligent
filter monitoring, we set standards in predictive maintenance. For industrial processes that run
smoothly.

][129]

Investing in research and development clearly pays off. That's why we rely on our global research

# 1A Auto: Aftermarket Auto Parts Online Retailer

[ 1A Auto][84] believes in empowering you, our customer, to do your own car repairs. We offer a
large selection of high quality car parts online, [ expert customer service ][85], and helpful
how-to automotive resources. Our experts aim to provide you with everything, aside from a spare pair
of hands, to fix your car yourself. read more

We strive daily to find the best aftermarket car parts available. All our online auto parts, from [
headlights ][86] to [side-view mirrors][87], and [shocks][88] and [struts][89], are made of the
highest quality materials and rigorously tested for longevity, direct fit, and function. We
guarantee our replacement parts will fit as well as the original equipment. All online auto parts
you buy from 1A Auto will function as well as or better than the OEM parts, whether it’s as simple
as brake [pads][90] or as complex as a [tow mirror][91]. We are so confident in our aftermarket
parts that we guarantee correct fit for every part. Additionally, we offer some of the longest
warranties in the automotive industry.

### Expert US-Based Automotive Customer Service and Fast & Free Shipping

Our friendly and knowledgeable customer service team is always ready to help. We staff our toll-free
US-based call center with auto experts excited to answer all your questions. Feel free to ask
anything about any of our products, including fit or installation. We want you to get exactly the
replacement part you need the first time around. We are well versed in all vehicle makes and models
whether your car is domestic like a [Ford][92], [Chevy][93], or [Dodge][94], or an import such as a
[Toyota][95], [Honda][96], [Volkswagen][97], or [BMW][98].

Standard shipping is always free in the continental US. Order before 2pm Eastern Time, Monday –
Friday, and your parts will ship from one of our auto parts warehouse the same day. That way you get
your parts and accessories fast, so you can get back on the road quickly.

### Extensive Auto Repair Video Library and Resources

1A Auto provides a comprehensive [automotive video library][99] to show you how you can
do-it-yourself. We rock auto repair videos by posting thousands of videos showing repairs across
many years, makes, and models. Our mechanics aspire to provide the exact video you need for your
specific automotive repair job. These range from complete repair instructions to helpful tips and
tricks, all to help DIYers maintain everything from sports cars to heavy duty trucks.

Choose 1A Auto when looking to buy auto parts online because we empower you to fix your own vehicle.
We’ve helped millions of people do their own repairs from the first-timer hoping to save a few
hundred dollars to the self-declared parts geek.

## 1A Auto Blog

Our team of automotive experts come together to create the [1A Auto Blog][100]. It’s packed full of
stories, videos, how-to guides, and diagnostic articles. This is just another way we hope to empower
you to fix your car yourself, saving hundreds of dollars in the process!

metal][44], [knitted wire mesh][45], wire cloth, [sintering and brazing][46], crimping, [wire

We offer rapid prototyping and have over 1,000,000 sq. ft. of manufacturing space across the globe,
which allows us to scale new products smoothly from concept to mass production. As a vertically
integrated wire mesh manufacturer, we ensure quality and efficiency throughout the entire production
process. We have locations in Rhode Island and Texas, USA, as well as Romania, Mexico, China, India,
and Germany with customer support representatives available in additional geographies. This means
that wherever you are in the world, ACS has [representatives nearby][60] ready to begin solving for
your manufacturing needs. Our global sourcing strategy allows us to always find the best raw
material fit for any given project.

# Dedicated Engineering Support for Custom Solutions

Our engineers bring a wealth of experience and know-how to the table. They get involved early in
each of our projects, often making site visits to make sure ACS is producing parts and components
that fit perfectly into both your manufacturing process and your finished product. The ACS
Engineering Team can often find novel ways to eliminate waste, speed up production time, or improve
end-product performance by going beyond the drawings and developing a deep understanding of our
clients’ operations. Explore our [innovative solutions][61].

## The Trusted Name in Membrane Filtration 

For more than 30 years, Aria Filtra® has developed, implemented, and maintained water filtration
solutions that perform as needed for longer than expected. Customers turn to us to help them tackle
their toughest water challenges because they know our best-in-class solutions, coupled with our
technical expertise and unwavering pride in our craft, will deliver a high return on their
investment and lower operating expenses.

Loading video...

## Markets We Serve

Supporting Municipal and Industrial Customers Across North America

[water header banner 1480]

## Municipal

Our systems treat more than one billion gallons of water for thousands of municipalities every day.
We have a proven track record of delivering reliable water treatment systems for municipalities.

[water header banner 1480]

## Refining & Chemical Manufacturing

Aria Filtra membrane-based solutions provide treatment tools to fit the unique water and wastewater
needs for refineries.

[water header banner 1480]

## Mining and Metals

We help mining operations meet current and future environmental requirements when treating raw water
and maintaining high-quality water standards.

[water header banner 1480]

## Power Generation

Aria Filtra is a leader in fluid purification technologies. We assist power plants in improving
reliability and ensuring clean, available, and profitable power.

[water header banner 1480]

## Pulp and Paper

Serving the pulp and paper industry for more than 30 years. Unlike conventional clarifier and
multimedia filters, membrane technology can easily handle upset conditions such as total suspended
solids (TSS) and turbidity.

[water header banner 1480]

## Food and Beverage

Providing the food and beverage industry with reliable membrane solutions that can decrease waste
and provide significant savings when compared to conventional treatment and filtration.

## About Us

Our experienced team paired with our wide range of products, will help solve your toughest water
challenges. We've put our systems through rigorous testing and extensive quality control checks to
ensure they perform as needed, so you can be confident that your mission-critical operations will
continue to function.

## Pall Water is now Aria Filtra

But, the only thing that changed was our name. As Aria Filtra, we've proudly stayed true to who we
were as Pall Water. Our unwavering passion for improving water quality and our pride in our craft
have established us as the trusted choice in water filtration.

Applying our expertise, proven technology, and durable solutions to ensure you have access to the
high-quality water you need.

## Proudly Part of Trojan Technologies

Trojan Technologies delivers products and services that play vital roles in making the various
stages of the water treatment process more effective and efficient. As a division of Trojan
Technologies, Aria Filtra is committed to delivering high-quality, high-performance, and
long-lasting solutions that help customers meet their water quality objectives. It's through our
passion for engineering excellence that we're able to continuously improve our solutions and
introduce new innovations that will help address the water concerns of our changing world.

[Aria Filtra is Part of Trojan Technologies]
[Proudly Part of Trojan Technologies]

designed to solve the most complex water treatment challenges. With more than 650 system
installations across North America, we are the filtration partner of choice for municipal and
industrial customers that need reliable access to consistent, high-quality water.

## Markets We Serve

[water header banner 1480]

## Municipal

Our systems treat more than one billion gallons of water for thousands of municipalities every day.

[water header banner 1480]

Aria Filtra membrane-based solutions provide treatment tools to fit the unique water and wastewater
needs for refineries.

[water header banner 1480]

## Mining and Metals

We help mining operations meet current and future environmental requirements when treating raw water
and maintaining high-quality water standards.

[water header banner 1480]

## Power Generation

Aria Filtra is a leader in fluid purification technologies. We assist power plants in improving
reliability and ensuring clean, available, and profitable power.

[water header banner 1480]

## Pulp and Paper

Serving the pulp and paper industry for more than 30 years. Unlike conventional clarifier and
multimedia filters, membrane technology can easily handle upset conditions such as total suspended
solids (TSS) and turbidity.

[water header banner 1480]

## Food and Beverage

Providing the food and beverage industry with reliable membrane solutions that can decrease waste
and provide significant savings when compared to conventional treatment and filtration.

challenges. We've put our systems through rigorous testing and extensive quality control checks to
ensure they perform as needed, so you can be confident that your mission-critical operations will
continue to function.

were as Pall Water. Our unwavering passion for improving water quality and our pride in our craft

high-quality water you need.

The two companies, promoters of Made in Italy in the world, renew the bond that already united them,
strengthening it towards new challenges and goals to be achieved together.The partnership that began
years ago will continue for the 2024, 2025 and 2026 seasons. Over time, BMC has been committed to
supporting the House of Sant'Agata Bolognese by supplying OEM products and complete intake kits for
both road and GT race cars.The collaboration between Lamborghini and BMC began more than ten years
ago, when the two Emilian companies worked together on the Lamborghini Gallardo Super Trofeo
project…
